mapper.insert: INSERT INTO persona_admin_feedback (id, persona_id, platform, bot_id, group_id, tag, comment, trace_id, operator, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{personaId}, #{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{tag}, #{comment}, #{traceId}, #{operator}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, persona_id AS personaId, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, tag, comment, trace_id AS traceId, operator, created_at AS createdAt FROM persona_admin_feedback WHERE persona_id = #{personaId} AND created_at >= #{since} ORDER BY created_at DESC
